home.heroDescription: BloodBridge is a real-time connector connecting patients, hospitals, and volunteers with verified blood donors instantly. Managed by an advanced accountability metrics system.
home.drsDescription: No more fake promises. Our proprietary DRS system tracks real donation logs, rewarding active heroes and ensuring real-time response accountability.
home.instantDonorMatchingDescription: We query matching donors within your city, checking compatibility charts and sorted dynamically by reliability scores.
home.realtimeSocketsDescription: Hospital emergency rooms can trigger high-alert SOS signals broadcasting instant socket popups to O- and compatible groups.
home.securityBadgesDescription: Donor phones remain strictly hidden until confirm commitments. Earn Gold badges and unlock city achievements!
home.footerText: © 2026 Emergency Blood Connector System. Free humanitarian program.
